explained.tdh.day.eyebrow: The daily check · a day's receipt
explained.tdh.day.title: The result dated {date}
explained.tdh.day.lede: One day's comparison on one receipt, in a fixed order: every value its file reports, every hash needed to check it, and the file's hash computed in your browser.
explained.tdh.day.nav.label: Other days
explained.tdh.day.nav.openLabel: {date}: open, its result comes after its snapshot
explained.tdh.day.missing.headline: The index lists this day, but its file could not be read.
explained.tdh.day.missing.headlineFeed: The feed could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.
explained.tdh.day.missing.body: The receipt is built from the day's own file. It is shown here as soon as the file can be read again.
explained.tdh.day.row.historyNote: logs as public log servers report them; nothing checks them against Ethereum's block headers yet
explained.tdh.day.row.drift: The rules are now named TDH v1.4, and P26's rule version is {version}, with four-wallet consolidation. Files written under the new name carry a new rule ID, {ruleId}, so their roots change.
explained.tdh.day.row.driftEqual: This day is equal on every identity, so no compared identity had a fourth wallet.
explained.tdh.day.row.current: This file was written under the current rules, TDH v1.4 (D137), with four-wallet consolidation (D136): its rule ID and registry hash are the ones P26 states. Files written under the old name carry the old rule ID, so their roots differ.
explained.tdh.day.row.cycleRootNote: The {size} bytes that stand for the whole day: the root a validator signs for it (D144). So far only 6529's own validators sign, in testing.
explained.tdh.day.row.cycleRootRetired: Computed under the retired {version} rules, whose rule ID is above, so it is not the root a TDH v1.4 validator computes for this day.
explained.tdh.day.row.walletRootNote: A hash tree over every wallet's record for the day.
explained.tdh.day.row.historyRootNote: A hash tree over every log read from the four contracts that count, from their deployment to the day's end.
explained.tdh.day.row.inputNote: published as a hash only; the file itself is not public yet
explained.tdh.day.row.fileNote: {file}, written {written}; its SHA-256 in the feed's index is {hash}.
explained.tdh.day.row.fileNoteLate: {file}, written {written}, later than a day's usual run: a late or re-run result (↻). Its SHA-256 in the index is {hash}.
explained.tdh.day.glance.label: The day at a glance
explained.tdh.day.totals.label: Two right totals
explained.tdh.day.totals.body: This total counts the two burn addresses, as 6529.io does. A validator's total would leave them out, and this file does not publish that one yet. For the day of {date} the two were {withBurn} and {withoutBurn}.
explained.tdh.day.own.label: Writing your own TDH?
explained.tdh.day.own.body: Match every identity's final TDH and the totals: the {spec} restates every rule, and {pin} lists what a day's run pins. Then diff your records, one by one, with 6529.io's signed uploads of {identities} and {wallets}, on Arweave, to find any miss. The roots' encodings (P28, P11) are not public yet, so the roots cannot be recomputed today.
explained.tdh.day.act.note: The text has every hash in full; the JSON is the day's file exactly as the feed serves it.
explained.tdh.day.text.title: The result dated {date}, cycle {cycle}
explained.tdh.day.builds.label: The builds
explained.tdh.day.builds.caption: The programs that computed this day, and what each ran
explained.tdh.day.builds.note: The validator code, with the Rust core, is published when the owner decides (D116); no date is set. Until then the commits name exactly what ran.
explained.tdh.day.hwk.fileBody: {file} from the public feed, written {written}; read {read}; hashed by this page's server as it read the file, and again in your browser.
explained.tdh.day.hwk.rulesBody: D136, D137; P26 in 6529's design record at {commit} (registry {registry}, rule ID {ruleId}).
explained.tdh.day.hwk.totalsBody: P26 §13's replay of cycle {cycle} gives both totals; proof A's statement for the same cycle, in the validator's contracts record, holds the second.
explained.tdh.day.notFound.metaTitle: No published day · The daily check · 6529 Explained
explained.tdh.day.notFound.title: No published day {day}
explained.tdh.day.notFound.body: The daily comparison publishes one file per cycle, from {first} (cycle {cycle}) to the latest closed cycle. This address names no day the feed holds.
explained.tdh.day.notFound.future: Cycle {day} closes at {close} on {date}, so it has no result yet. Each result is published about {after} after its snapshot.
explained.tdh.day.notFound.before: Cycle {day} ({date}) is before the first published day, {first} (cycle {cycle}).
explained.tdh.day.notFound.proved: This is the day program A proved in zero knowledge, under the retired rules; {link} shows its statement and its proof.
explained.tdh.day.notFound.uploads: 6529.io's own uploads for earlier days are on Arweave, listed in {link}.
